import time
from pathlib import Path
import serial
port = Path('/tmp/c6-port').read_text().strip()
ser = None
for _ in range(40):
    try:
        ser = serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=0.2, write_timeout=1)
        break
    except Exception:
        time.sleep(0.25)
if ser is None:
    raise SystemExit('failed to open C6 serial port after app-flash')
start = time.monotonic()
next_status = [15.0, 90.0, 165.0]
sent = 0
chunks = []
while time.monotonic() - start < 180.0:
    data = ser.read(4096)
    if data:
        chunks.append(data)
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
    while sent < len(next_status) and elapsed >= next_status[sent]:
        ser.write(b'link status\n')
        ser.flush()
        sent += 1
ser.close()
raw = b''.join(chunks)
Path('/tmp/c6-smoke.log').write_bytes(raw)
text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
keys = ('GatewayLink', 'zigbee stack ready', 'network restored', 'network formed', 'measurement ', 'input available ', 'ZIGBEE_DEVICE_', 'link backend=', 'link last_tx_ms=', 'panic', 'watchdog', 'security', 'dropped ')
for line in text.splitlines():
    if any(k.lower() in line.lower() for k in keys):
        print(line)
PY
